dialog: If you want to get past here/ you'll have to go through me!
It seems like if I take it too easy here things might be worse later.
For some reason/ you just caught my eye.
Oh/ what a splendid spot.
Shall we get started?
You put yourself in mortal peril for that strike/ so I think I'll oblige you.
Your sides are entirely undefended.
Well/ you did just attack me/ after all.
I suppose I'd best choke the life out of you now.
Do you reallly think you'll be making it back home?
As this is such a rare opportunity/ let's try to enjoy it/ shall we?
If you keep lazing around/ you might end up sleeping your last.
Oh nooo/ it's kill or be killed now!
There's now no guarantee I'll get out of this alive...
That's quite enough out of you. Now please rest in peace.
I won't have anymore nonsense coming from you.
Oh/ now how will this play out?
I wonder how well this will work?
Now/ fall nobly...
There/ go now.
It's your time...
Oh/ you too must pass...
Let's see...
I see my chance.
Just one quick thrust...
I'd like to welcome you to the other side!
I hope you'll enjoy your stay.
Even the ghosts are looking livelier than usual!
Start running.
My ghosts will dazzle you...
And there we go.
Oh dear/ if you go there you might end up haunted...
How unlucky!
Now/ my ghosts...
Fly over there!
What a pleasant spot for a dance...
Round and around we go...
Oh/ this area is just the perfect size.
Feel the rhythm...
Let me show you my dance.
I call this one... An Afternoon Nap".
Let me show you something neat.
Isn't it like something you once saw in a dream?
This is a poem about the Netherworld.
The butterfly of death flutters/ aiming not for the flowers
The moon rests in the still skies
Enjoy it while it lasts.
What a beautiful night...
I've been saving this for the right occasion.
If you find yourself entranced by the glittering butterfly of death...
If you find yourself entranced by the glittering butterfly of death...
There will be no escape for you.
What a beautiful night...
There is no running from death.
The Netherworld is calling for you...
And as you cannot escape...
Let's enjoy ourselves while it lasts.
What a beautiful night...
It's important to know when to take it easy.
I'll wait for the time to be right.
Oh my/ they vanished!
Come on/ come a little closer.
I'm going to haunt you for that!
I think it's best if I take charge here.
Sorry to keep you waiting!
Looks like I've been called for!
I feel like having some fun/ so I'll help you out.
You can let me handle this.
Now now/ we have to put more care into how we do it.
Try defeating me first.
Oh/ don't worry. You needn't fret.
Not a bad choice/ in my opinion.
OoooOOoooOoo!
It'd be best if we targeted that one/ yes?
Leading the way like this/ I'm a regular spirit guide!
Please handle the rest/ if you would?
Well/ I think I'll pitch in a bit!
Perhaps I'll prepare the way for you.
Let's call them to their doom together!
I think this is an absolutely splendid opportunity!
This is a chance to really enjoy ourselves!
...It's almost like she was trying to look after me.
I'm going to trust you with the rest/ okay/ Chen?
I do worry about you when you're all on your own/ Chen.
Chen/ it's dangerous to play around right there!
I'm glad I was here watching out for you.
Where should we go next/ Chen?
Chen/ should we aim for that one?
Are you okay handling the rest of this on your own/ Chen?
Let's go/ Chen!
Let's fight them over there/ Chen!
Chen/ I think we're both in fine form today!
I can really rely on you now/ Chen.
Chen/ let's both do our bests.
What did you just do to my Youmu?
Oh/ Youmu/ you're always in such a rush.
Youmu/ wait for meee!
Youmu/ you got in too close.
Youmu/ this is what happens when you rush things.
Slice and dice them for me/ would you?
I'm looking forward to seeing Youmu in action!
Youmu/ if you would.
Youmu/ please handle the rest.
Here I go/ Youmu.
Youmu/ there's no need to be nervous.
Youmu/ wait for meee!
Let's send them off together/ Youmu.
Let me see you in action up close/ Youmu.
Let's both do our bests/ Youmu.
This is just what I didn't want to happen...
Ran/ I think it best if I take charge here.
How surprising for you to fail to bring them down/ Ran!
Ran/ you got in too close.
Ran/ you're being too hasty.
Wouldn't it be nice if we could be over with Yukari too?
I'm sure you can handle this/ can't you/ Ran?
I'll leave it to you/ Ran!
That one/ Ran.
Ran/ please handle the rest.
Ran/ I think this is a splendid opportunity!
It's so rare for me to get to spend quality time with Ran/ this is quite nice!
Let's both do our bests/ Ran.
...Give me Yukari back.
Oh/ what's this? Are you leaving some for me?
Oh dear/ how'd that happen? There's this easy-to-hit enemy still undefeated right there...
That was a close one/ wasn't it/ Yukari? Try to keep it together.
You've left yourself completely open from behind/ Yukari.
No fair/ leave some for me/ Yukari!
I don't want to leave it ALL up to you.
I'd like to let Yukari have some time to relax.
Let's see/ what can I do here...
Could you handle the rest/ Yukari?
It's the perfect moment for this.
I'd like to watch Yukari's danmaku from up close...
Yukari/ let's both fight!
I'd best buy her some drinks to thank her later...
Suika/ I think it best if I take charge here.
Suika can be pretty sloppy sometimes...
I'm riiight behind yooou... Good thing/ huh?
Suika/ you're leaving too many openings right now!
Even when you're seeing double/ you know which one I'm aiming at/ right?
Once this is all over/ I'd like to have a drink or two with you!
Oooh/ spooky/ there's an oni coming for you!
I'm sure you can handle this/ can't you/ Suika?
Could you handle the rest/ Suika?
Suika/ let's make this party even more festive!
Suika/ I think this is a splendid opportunity!
Nothing matches better than Sake and Cherry Blossoms.
Eirin/ what's that saying? Heal thyself"?
Did you plan for me to be right here?
Eirin/ I think it best if I take charge here.
You must be in a rush/ Eirin.
Did you make an error in your calculations/ Eirin?
I wonder what sort of medicine you'll use next?
I'll leave their final moments to you/ Eirin.
Eirin/ I'm certain you can handle this/ right?
I think we can solve what ails them/ right Eirin?
I wonder if there are any medicines that affect ghosts?
Eirin/ I think this is a splendid opportunity!
I imagine this is all part of your calculations?
Eirin/ I'll be with you.
I really messed up here...
Murasa/ they're only listing/ not sinking.
And lurking behind that spooky ghost? Another ghost!
Murasa/ you're being too hasty.
You can be so eager to plunge into things/ Murasa.
And lurking behind that spooky ghost? Another ghost!
Murasa/ let's drag them down.

Murasa/ that one.
I'll leave choosing our course to you/ Murasa.
Let's both do our bests/ Murasa.

I won't let this be my last dance.
I call this dance/ The Flight of the Danmaku"!
Aww/ could you try a little harder?
I love jokes as much as the next person/ but there's a time and place for them.
Well/ I can tell how hard you're trying...
It's just lacking a certain something... You understand/ right?
Is that all the spirit you can muster?
Things are going ever more pear-shaped!
I wonder how things turned out this badly...
I'm getting dizzy!
Perhaps I'm a bit out of my depth...
Stop that this instant.
You're being frightfully rude/ you know!
Oh/ did I accidentally reveal my hand?
Oh my/ that was a bit rough of you...
Oh dear/ you saw through me.
I might be headed for an early grave...
Well/ things don't always go your way.
I'd prefer it if we took this at a more relaxing pace!
Some people have no manners/ I suppose.
Hmph/ you're getting far too worked up!
Ouch... I'm not much in the mood to enjoy playing at a disadvantage right now.
I'd prefer it if there were a chance to catch my breath...
Oh/ how clumsy of me.
Ah ah ah/ it won't be that easy!
What absurd attack motions. Or was that supposed to be some kind of dance?
Danmaku of that quality simply won't work.
I'd best take this slow and steady.
I call this dance/ The Flight of the Danmaku"!
Round and around and around...
I had your number/ but this still feels a bit risky...
Almost too easy... will there be some kind of catch to this?
That was well-aimed/ it felt like a real battle!
I'll have you know/ I can be rather light on my feet.
I'm not interested.
Oh/ I suppose I'll have to pay a little more attention.
I'd prefer if you wouldn't try to touch me so casually.
If we're supposed to be fighting/ I'd wish you'd make it a bit more convincing.
This is a skill issue/ isn't it?
Oh/ now this is quite handy.
It's handy/ but I shouldn't rely too much on this...
Super Ninja Art... Parry no Jutsu!
No no/ you can't go spacing out like that.
Perhaps I was called here by the scent of death...
In battle/ the wheel of fortune ever turns!
I'll haunt you afterwards...
Oh dear/ I lost?
I hadn't planned on losing... for now/ I suppose I'll have to leave this to the rest of the group.
I'm feeling a bit peckish/ so I'm off. I hope everyone can handle the rest!
Oh dear/ I lost?
You're a great deal stronger than I figured...
I hadn't planned on losing... but for now I'll be withdrawing.
Aw/ I lost. I'll leave the rest to you girls!
That's plenty enough destruction out of you. I'll be suppressing that power of yours now.
I'm not usually one to rush/ but needs must.
Well/ first let's give you a quick drubbing...
That looks fun/ allow me to join in as well.
A messenger from the Dragon Palace? This must be a big deal...
You seem quite relaxed/ but you have a serious side as well.
Making an incident to stave off boredom? Let's hold off on that for now/ okay?
A sword that can find the weakpoints in your temperament? Oooh/ how scary!
Settle down/ right this instant.
You're going to have to tell us the whole story.
What a beastly creature.
You're a tough one/ but I bet you could be made edible.
A nightmare is also a kind of evil spirit/ after all!
Hmm... all considered/ you still seem a bit half-baked.
Oh/ have we met?
What a horrid version of myself...
This is the last thing I'd want to see.
...I won't avert my eyes from this.
Settle down/ right this instant.
Goodness gracious but you are tenacious!
That power just feels a bit risky to use somehow!
How about you give some consideration as to surrendering?
This danmaku battle is already over.
Oh/ how comfy looking...
Let's see just how deep your plans go.
They say you should dream big/ after all...
Now/ just whose nightmare will this be?
My death-colored cherry blossoms will paint the end of this dream.
